# KRONATRIX for Authors

> Official author and book website service from KRONATRIX. This file summarises the public site and points agents to the canonical pages.

## Canonical entities
- [KRONATRIX for Authors](https://authors.kronatrix.co.uk/) — personalised websites for authors and individual books.
- [KRONATRIX](https://kronatrix.co.uk/) — parent brand.
- Contact: kronatrix.ai@gmail.com

## Core services
- [Personalised Book Preview Website](https://authors.kronatrix.co.uk/book-preview-websites.html) — £500 one-time. A dedicated destination for one book, with a controlled preview of less than 10%, purchase/follow/email-list pathways, and search/AI-readable public information.
- [Personalised Author Website](https://authors.kronatrix.co.uk/author-websites.html) — £500 one-time. A long-term author home for biography, books, proof, social profiles, mailing list and reader pathways.
- Full Advertising Package — from £5,000/month. Managed Google, Facebook and Instagram advertising; scope can increase the monthly fee and media spend is separate.

The two standard £500 website packages are one-time KRONATRIX website services with no monthly KRONATRIX hosting fee for the standard setup. Optional domains or other third-party costs are separate where requested.

## Claims policy
KRONATRIX does not guarantee indexing, rankings, Google AI Overview inclusion, ChatGPT recommendations, AI citations, book sales, author fame, six-figure revenue or advertising results. The service improves controllable foundations: crawlability, clarity, useful content, real proof, structured information, user experience and conversion paths.

## Current AI-search context
- [Google: New opportunities, control and insights for website owners](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/search/new-controls-website-owners/) — June 2026; Google describes increased use of generative AI for finding and understanding information.
- [Google Search I/O 2026 updates](https://blog.google/products-and-platforms/products/search/search-io-2026/) — May 2026; AI Mode growth and conversational Search.
- [OpenAI: ChatGPT Search](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/9237897-chatgpt-search) — official explanation of ChatGPT web search.

These external sources support the general shift toward conversational and AI-assisted discovery. They do not guarantee that KRONATRIX clients will be cited or recommended.
